The value-add of this deeper --full re-audit is: (a) 6 DEDUP findings reconcile to existing OPEN ledger entries (still-open carryover); (b) 5 findings are surfaced that were NOT previously open ledger findings -- DEDUP-005, DEDUP-007, DEDUP-008, DEDUP-009 are genuinely new, and DEDUP-001 is UN-SUPPRESSED from its prior known-issue suppression and promoted to a reportable finding.

Those are Law-1 / Law-3 footguns beyond intentional forfeiture. KEPT -- distinction documented per task.

DEDUP-006 is kept ONLY for the NON-OBVIOUS permanent-brick footgun (Law-3), not the drain. DEDUP-008 is kept ONLY for the false on-chain recovery PROMISE (Law-2), not the drain.
registeredKnownIssues.KI-6: Pauser trust (pause/unpause) -- the pauser-sandwich selective-yield-denial is already ledger C-04/L-05 (flagged partial-match-KI-6). No new pauser-malice finding raised. DEDUP-006's pauser==0 angle is a non-obvious footgun, not pauser malice.

registeredKnownIssues.KI-9: External yield strategy behavior (OOS) -- not touched; no DEDUP finding depends on strategy internals.
registeredKnownIssues.KI-10: Zero-APY supported and expected -- DEDUP-005's over-mint requires NON-ZERO APY. Zero-APY immunizes the phUSD stream, which LOWERS likelihood (reflected in DEDUP-005's Medium adjudication), but does NOT make it a KI match: non-zero APY is an operator-selectable, documented mode, so the inflation is a real Law-3 footgun. KEPT.

designDecisionTension_DEDUP001.decision: KEEP / DO NOT SUPPRESS DEDUP-001 (Linear-Depletion implemented as exponential decay).
designDecisionTension_DEDUP001.previousState: In phlimbo-ea-03 this exact root cause was placed in the ledger suppressed[] set (fingerprint 9f7c191e..., semanticFingerprint phlimbo:_updatePool+collectReward+setDepletionDuration:V1-rate-reanchor) with reason 'known-issue' matched to lib/phlimbo-ea/CLAUDE.md V1 'DO NOT MODIFY'.
reasonsToOverturnSuppression: It is NOT present in the registry's formal knownIssues[] list (KI-1..KI-10). The only supports for suppression are (a) designDecisions[2] 'Rate recalculates after each balance change' and (b) the submodule CLAUDE.md V1 label.

designDecisions[] is NOT the same authority as knownIssues[]. DD-2 merely DESCRIBES the recompute mechanism; it does not bless the EMERGENT consequence (a tranche delivers only ~63% within its window, ~37% under-delivery at t=D, path-dependent, stranded tail). A described mechanism != an accepted impact.

The submodule CLAUDE.md explicitly calls it 'the V1 rate-recompute BUG' -- a bug label, not a feature blessing. 'DO NOT MODIFY' is a source-control instruction (V1 is frozen/deployed), not a statement that the behaviour is correct or harmless.

Upstream's own PhlimboV2 (story-020) REMOVES this exact recompute. A genuine, intended design decision would not be deliberately reverted in the successor. The V2 fix contradicts treating V1's behaviour as a blessed design choice.

Law 1 (recall beats report-tidiness): a quantified, Tier-3 CONFIRMED value-delay/stranding defect in the contract's headline advertised feature ('Linear Depletion') must be surfaced at honest severity, not buried as a known issue, especially when the formal known-issue list omits it.
designDecisionTension_DEDUP001.tensionDisclosedInFinding: The three-way tension (designDecisions[2] arguably blesses it | CLAUDE.md calls it a bug | PhlimboV2 removes it) MUST be documented inside the finding so the human adjudicator sees both sides. Severity held at honest Medium.
